_mod_cb.desc: Returns the remainder when the first input is divided by the second input (both BitVec<32>); if the second input is zero, returns zero.

pow2_cb.desc: Returns 2 raised to the power of the input (BitVec<32>), computed as 1 left-shifted by the input amount.

intand_cb.desc: Returns conjunction of second and third inputs (BitVec<32>). The first input is ignored.

intor_cb.desc: Returns disjunction of second and third inputs (BitVec<32>). The first input is ignored.

intxor_cb.desc: Returns XOR of second and third inputs (BitVec<32>). The first input is ignored.

in_range_cb.desc: Returns 1 if the second input lies between 0 and 2 raised to the power of the first input (inclusive); otherwise, returns 0. All inputs are BitVec<32>

ite_zero_cb.desc: Returns the second input if the first input (BitVec<32>) is equal to zero; otherwise, returns the third input.
